package.name: dummy_vlm
package.description: Team Xiao Hei AI module launcher. The package name and launch file (dummy_vlm.launch) are kept from the challenge template so the evaluation's `ros2 launch dummy_vlm dummy_vlm.launch` invocation still works; it now brings up our scene_gemini pipeline (frontier exploration + perception scene graph + Gemini answering) instead of the C++ dummy.
